# The Vibe Company

> AI-native agency based in Paris (Y Combinator W24). We build AI products,
> automate operations with agents, and train teams. Our own agency runs on AI,
> so we ship 50 to 100 times faster than a traditional team.

## What we do
- Build AI products and internal tools end to end
- Deploy agents to automate sales, support, content and admin operations
- AI strategy and training for leaders: map the stack, prioritize, train the team
